Five targeted component tests pass: balance DOM events execute through the real reducer and replay; edits/comparisons preserve hero AP and committed puzzle/output state; hidden totals use only printed or inferred values; exhausted comparison allowance permits recorded repeats; nonogram gives adjacent clues and immutable givens; packing supports keyboard anchors, six rotations, tier-gated reflection, illegal-placement feedback and a full solver packing through actual input events. These are jsdom/hook/reducer tests using explicit test fixtures, not browser or certified mission evidence. Initial sandbox bundler access failed; the same narrowly scoped check ran successfully with escalation. One test expectation incorrectly counted the initial reserve subtotal and was corrected.
